ccta-img-1.alt: Labelled coronary segment diagram with RCA, LAD and LCx branches.
ccta-img-1.caption: Coronary segment map, including right and left posterior descending supply. Anatomical diagram, not a patient reconstruction.
ccta-img-1.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Csilla Celeng, Richard Takx, Robin Smithuis and Tim Leiner; SCCT segment diagram credited in the source

ccta-img-2.alt: LAD curved CT reconstruction alongside invasive coronary angiography.
ccta-img-2.caption: Published LAD stenosis example: curved CT reconstruction on the left and angiographic correlation on the right.
ccta-img-2.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Csilla Celeng, Richard Takx, Robin Smithuis and Tim Leiner

ccta-img-3.alt: Volume rendering labels left main, circumflex and obtuse marginal branch.
ccta-img-3.caption: Left coronary branching on volume rendering. The circumflex and obtuse marginal branch are labelled; this is a VR example.
ccta-img-3.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Robin Smithuis and Tineke Willems

ccta-img-4.alt: Right coronary volume rendering with posterior descending artery labelled.
ccta-img-4.caption: Right-dominant coronary anatomy: the RCA gives rise to the PDA. Acute marginal and conus branches are also labelled.
ccta-img-4.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Robin Smithuis and Tineke Willems

ccta-img-5.alt: Coronary CT showing a mid-LAD stent with magnified lumen.
ccta-img-5.caption: Mid-LAD stent example; the source describes minimal in-stent restenosis.
ccta-img-5.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Csilla Celeng, Richard Takx, Robin Smithuis and Tim Leiner

ccta-img-6.alt: Contrast CT with arrows indicating pulmonary arterial filling defects.
ccta-img-6.caption: Pulmonary emboli illustrate why the extracoronary review matters in a chest-pain examination.
ccta-img-6.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Csilla Celeng, Richard Takx, Robin Smithuis and Tim Leiner

ccta-img-7.alt: Coronary CT with magnified LAD plaque and central contrast-filled lumen.
ccta-img-7.caption: Magnified plaque detail demonstrates the source's napkin-ring example; no quantitative diameter measurement is shown.
ccta-img-7.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Csilla Celeng, Richard Takx, Robin Smithuis and Tim Leiner

ccta-img-8.alt: CT-derived fractional flow reserve model with coronary values labelled.
ccta-img-8.caption: Published CT-FFR model with LAD and distal RCA values labelled 0.58 and 0.75.
ccta-img-8.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Csilla Celeng, Richard Takx, Robin Smithuis and Tim Leiner

prostate-img-1.alt: Sagittal and axial prostate MRI with three gland dimensions marked.
prostate-img-1.caption: Gland measurement example with 36, 50 and 60 mm diameters for ellipsoid volume estimation.
prostate-img-1.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Georgios Agrotis, Rhiannon van Loenhout, Frank Zijta, Robin Smithuis and Ivo Schoots

prostate-img-2.alt: Prostate sector diagram at base, mid-gland and apex.
prostate-img-2.caption: Sector anatomy for locating lesions consistently. This is an anatomical reference, not a populated patient lesion map.
prostate-img-2.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Rhiannon van Loenhout, Frank Zijta, Robin Smithuis and Ivo Schoots

prostate-img-3.alt: Right peripheral-zone lesion on T2, ADC and diffusion MRI.
prostate-img-3.caption: Peripheral-zone cancer example with matched T2, ADC and DWI panels; the source assigns PI-RADS 5.
prostate-img-3.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Georgios Agrotis, Rhiannon van Loenhout, Frank Zijta, Robin Smithuis and Ivo Schoots

prostate-img-4.alt: Left peripheral-zone lesion with low ADC and high DWI signal.
prostate-img-4.caption: A separate left-sided example demonstrates diffusion restriction and broad contact with the prostate margin.
prostate-img-4.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Georgios Agrotis, Rhiannon van Loenhout, Frank Zijta, Robin Smithuis and Ivo Schoots

prostate-img-5.alt: Anterior prostate lesion on T2, ADC, DWI and DCE panels.
prostate-img-5.caption: Anterior tumour example with DCE correlation. The four panels demonstrate the same lesion across sequences.
prostate-img-5.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Georgios Agrotis, Rhiannon van Loenhout, Frank Zijta, Robin Smithuis and Ivo Schoots

prostate-img-6.alt: Axial prostate MRI showing bulky tumour and irregular posterolateral margin.
prostate-img-6.caption: Locally advanced tumour example for reviewing the prostate margin and neurovascular-bundle region.
prostate-img-6.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Georgios Agrotis, Rhiannon van Loenhout, Frank Zijta, Robin Smithuis and Ivo Schoots

prostate-img-7.alt: Prostate-base tumour marked on T2 and ADC images.
prostate-img-7.caption: Published seminal-vesicle invasion example, showing prostate-base tumour and corresponding low ADC.
prostate-img-7.attribution: Radiology Assistant · Georgios Agrotis, Rhiannon van Loenhout, Frank Zijta, Robin Smithuis and Ivo Schoots

prostate-img-8.alt: Pelvic MRI with an arrow identifying a sacral lesion.
prostate-img-8.caption: Bone-metastasis example illustrates review beyond the prostate within the pelvic field of view.
